relations: Moisture on the metal surfaces drives oxidation, causing the brown textured regions to expand across the plates.
The white paper towel wicks away excess liquid, controlling the drying speed of the reactive chemical patterns.

The boundary between the bare gray metal and the rusted zone shifts as the liquid continues to react.
